_comment: The operator's own programs that use the GPU heavily (2026-10-22: 'dedicate ... 1 GPU core to whatever I want to do on my PC, like play Helldivers 2'). While any of these runs, every verification rig waits before booting the game (scripts/lib/machine-guard.js). Add a program by its .exe name, lower case. Light programs (Discord, a browser playing YouTube) need no entry: a rig at 30 frames a second does not disturb them.
_found: Exe names read from the operator's Steam library (D:\Steam\steamapps\common) on 2026-10-22.
